## 1. Executive verdict
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
39
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
40
IDM-MCP should be a local, Windows-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) service that safely turns an **authorized, technically downloadable resource** into a durable job, submits it to the installed IDM through Tonec's documented COM API, and independently verifies the resulting file.
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
41
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
42
The requested literal guarantee—“every link from every site, always downloaded in any requested quality/container”—cannot be implemented honestly by IDM, an MCP server, or any other downloader. A URL may identify an HTML page rather than a media file; a requested rendition may not exist; a signed media URL may expire; a stream may be encrypted/DRM-protected; a platform may prohibit automated downloading; a server, network, disk, account, or IDM may fail. YouTube in particular prohibits automated access and downloading except where the service or the relevant rights holders expressly authorize it. Owning an IDM license licenses IDM; it does not grant rights to third-party content or override a site's terms.
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
43
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
44
The robust promise is therefore:
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
45
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
46
> While the Windows account, Agent, and durable state store remain available, every accepted request receives an idempotent job and is driven toward a truthful terminal state. A job is called `completed_verified` only when the expected file exists at the authorized path and the configured verification evidence passes. Unsupported, protected, forbidden, unavailable, ambiguous, and failed cases are reported explicitly—never disguised as success and never silently substituted.
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
47
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
48
No software can guarantee progress while the machine is powered off, the state drive is destroyed, the user permanently prevents the Agent from running, or an external origin is unavailable forever. Those operating assumptions are explicit rather than hidden inside a “100%” claim.
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.

There is an essential integration gap: Tonec documents the panel as a browser-to-IDM workflow, while the public COM API accepts an already resolved download URL and does not expose “resolve this watch page” or “list panel renditions.” Seeing a panel label does not by itself give IDM-MCP the direct URL needed for `SendLinkToIDM2`. The design will not bridge that gap by reading private extension messages or hidden storage. A supported browser adapter must prove one of two fully visible/documented paths: (a) the UI exposes an authorized direct resource that can be vaulted and submitted through COM, or (b) clicking the official panel opens a visible IDM dialog where the exact service-owned staging path and frozen filename can be set and verified before start. `youtube.com`, `youtu.be`, and YouTube media hosts are `deny_automated_watch_download` by default.

YouTube's current Terms restrict accessing, reproducing, or downloading content except as expressly authorized by the service or with prior written permission from YouTube and the applicable rights holders, and restrict automated access absent specified permission. Its API policies separately prohibit API clients from downloading/caching audiovisual content without prior written approval and prohibit undocumented API access/circumvention. YouTube Premium offline downloads are an in-product encrypted/offline feature, not an arbitrary MP4/MKV export to a chosen filesystem path.

## 29. Final design position
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
1779
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
1780
IDM-MCP is viable and valuable as a local orchestration, policy, and verification layer over the licensed IDM installation. The high-confidence core is direct, authorized HTTP/HTTPS assets via Tonec's documented COM API. Quality/container selection becomes reliable only when a permitted discovery adapter can enumerate real candidates; it is not created by passing a watch-page URL to IDM. Browser-panel mediation is a gated extension, not the foundation. YouTube automation is default-blocked under current platform rules, with platform-authorized export/offline alternatives called out.
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
1781
−
IDM's archived design proposals; history, not part of the mirror.
1782
The defining engineering principle is simple: **submit only what can be authorized and represented, freeze exactly what was selected, and never call a file complete until independent evidence proves the requested result at the requested path.**

## Scheduler and queue caveats
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
319
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
320
- IDM has a main download queue, a synchronization queue, and arbitrary additional queues.
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
321
- Completed files are removed from a download queue. Synchronization items remain so IDM can check for server changes later.
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
322
- Each queue has its own start/stop schedule and simultaneous-file count.
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
323
- When a file fails, IDM moves it to the end of the queue. With no retry limit, a lone failing item is retried indefinitely at 30-second intervals.
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
324
- Completion actions can hang up, shut down the computer, force processes to terminate, or run a file/program. These are user-controlled, potentially destructive side effects.
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
325
- Scheduled execution requires IDM running in the notification area. Waking from sleep also depends on Windows wake-timer and sign-in settings.
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
326
−
IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
327
A service must not enable or change shutdown, hang-up, forced termination, executable post-actions, credentials, proxy settings, or infinite retries without explicit user intent. Prefer service-owned retry policy before submission when practical.

IDM's archived website research; history, not part of the mirror.
